text.body: ॥ bṛhatstotraratnākaraḥ॥ ॥ śrīśivāṣṭottaraśatanāmastotram ॥ śivo maheśvaraśśaṃbhuḥ pinākī śaśiśekharaḥ । vāmadevo virūpākṣaḥ kapardī nīlalohitaḥ ॥ 1 śaṅkaraśśūlapāṇiśca khaṭvāṅgī viṣṇuvallabhaḥ । śipiviṣṭoṃ'bikānāthaḥ śrīkaṇṭho bhaktavatsalaḥ ॥2 bhavaśśarvastrilokeśaśśitikaṇṭhaśśivāpriyaḥ । ugraḥ kapālī kāmārirandhakāsurasūdanaḥ ॥3 gaṅgādharo lalāṭākṣaḥ kālakālaḥ kṛpānidhiḥ। bhīmaḥ paraśuhastaśca mṛgapāṇirjaṭādharaḥ ॥4 kailāsavāsī kavacī kaṭhorastripurāntakaḥ। vṛṣāṅko vṛṣabhārūḍho bhasmoddhūlitavigrahaḥ ॥ sāmapriyaskharamayastrayīmūrtiranīśvaraḥ । sarvajñaḥ paramātmā ca somasūryāgnilocanaḥ ॥ haviryajñamayassomaḥ pañcavaktrasadāśivaḥ । viśveśvaro vīrabhadro gaṇanāthaḥ prajāpatiḥ ॥ hiraṇyaretā durdharṣo girīśo giriśo'naghaḥ । bhujaṅgabhūṣaṇo bhargo giridhanvā giripriyaḥ॥ kṛttivāsāḥ purārātirbhagavān pramathādhipaḥ । mṛtyuñjayassūkṣmatanurjagadvyāpī jagadguruḥ ॥ vyomakeśo mahāsenajanakaśvāruvikramaḥ । rudro bhūtapatiḥ sthāṇurahirbudhnyo digambaraḥ ॥ aṣṭamūrtiranekātmā sāttvikaśśuddhavigrahaḥ । śāśvataḥ khaṇḍaparaśurajaḥ pāśavimocakaḥ ।। mṛḍaḥ paśupatirdevo mahādevo'vyayo hariḥ । pūṣadantabhidavyagro dakṣādhvaraharo haraḥ ॥ bhaganetrabhidavyaktassahasrākṣassahasrapāt । apavargaprado'nantastārakaḥ parameśvaraḥ ॥ evaṃ śrīśaṃbhudevasya nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṃ śatam ॥ ॥śrīśivāṣṭottaraśatanāmastotraṃ samāptam ॥
